set_aside_reason: OTHER: Serious adverse event counts are reported, but no confidence interval for this endpoint is stated in any held source.

population.span: Patients who were 18 years of age or older (with no upper age limit) and who were hospitalized with Covid-19 pneumonia that had been confirmed by a positive polymerase-chain-reaction test and radiographic imaging were eligible for enrollment.

endpoint.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred

estimate.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 38 of 250 patients (15.2%) in the tocilizumab group and 25 of 127 patients (19.7%) in the placebo group.

analysis_set.span: Safety was assessed in all the patients who received either tocilizumab or placebo; patients were grouped according to the actual agent received.

treatment_strategy.span: we randomly assigned the patients, in a 2:1 ratio, to receive standard care plus one or two doses of either intravenous tocilizumab (8 mg per kilogram of body weight, to a maximum of 800 mg per dose) or placebo.

follow_up.span: Adverse Events through Day 60 in the Safety Population.

absent_reason: ci: No confidence interval for serious adverse events is reported in any supplied source.
served_mismatch: The served counts match the source, but the served analysis_set is incorrect: these are safety-population counts grouped by actual treatment received, not modified intention-to-treat counts grouped by randomized assignment. The endpoint applies through day 60. No OR or corresponding CI is printed.

candidate_rejections.span: Efficacy analyses were performed in the modified intention-to-treat population, with patients grouped according to treatment assignment.
candidate_rejections.why: Reject this analysis-set attribution for the served safety endpoint; it describes efficacy analyses, whereas serious adverse events were assessed in the safety population by actual treatment received.
